name: Wikipedia / Wikidata
label: Wikipedia / Wikidata
description: Wikipedia / Wikidata official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: wiki_search, wiki_page, wiki_summary, wikidata_entity. Docs: https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/API:Main_page. WMF User-Agent policy (identifying UA required). Wikipedia text CC BY-SA; Wikidata CC0. Do not scrape HTML. SPARQL is the Wikidata SPARQL node. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Wikipedia / Wikidata request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"wiki_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: wiki_search | wiki_page | wiki_summary | wikidata_entity. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'wiki_search'.

schema.label: exintro
schema.description: wiki_page: 1 to return only the lead section (exintro=1). Example: 1.

schema.label: srsearch
schema.description: MediaWiki list=search query (srsearch). Required on wiki_search. Example: Ada Lovelace.

schema.label: title
schema.description: URL-encoded title for wiki_summary REST /page/summary/{title}. Example: Ada_Lovelace.

schema.label: titles
schema.description: Page title(s) for wiki_page and wikidata_entity. Pipe-separated. Example: Ada_Lovelace.

schema.label: language
schema.description: Wikipedia language subdomain used in the host {language}.wikipedia.org. Overrides config language. Example: en | de | fr. Required by all ops when config is empty.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: wiki_search, wiki_page, wiki_summary, wikidata_entity.

configurationParameters.label: User Agent
configurationParameters.description: Sent as User-Agent on every request. Must identify the app with contact per WMF UA policy.

configurationParameters.label: Language
configurationParameters.description: Wiki language subdomain (en, de, …) interpolated into https://{language}.wikipedia.org.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 20. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
